summary: Excellent code quality across all files. Workflow YAML follows all standards: pinned actions (checkout@v4), least-privilege permissions (contents:read), proper triggers, set -euo pipefail in bash steps, GITHUB_OUTPUT usage. JavaScript implements clear TDD: single-purpose functions, meaningful error messages, proper input validation (parseVersion early), modular design. Bash test harness is well-structured with data-driven test cases, proper assertions on exact values, trap cleanup. No repetition, no dead code, comments explain 'why'. Only gap: deliverable lacks act-result.txt (required artifact showing tests passed through act) and fixture files (commits-feat.log, etc.) aren't shown, preventing full verification of end-to-end execution. Code would likely run successfully if those supporting files exist, but actual act validation steps aren't evidenced.
